U1: Migrate wiki to project repo (tagging, versioning). Effort: 1-2 days.
U2: Add Hadoop namenode specifics in a config file for DSL sessions. Effort: 2-3 days.
U3: Use jdbchdfs batch job as a passthrough (no chunk processing). Effort: 3-4 days.
U4: Decouple execution context from job launch lifecycle in Spring Batch, upgrade XD to Batch release, refactor XD-2486 workaround. Effort: 5-8 days.
U5: Create custom job module using Java Config, fix deployment/launch error. Effort: 3-4 days.
U6: Continue XD-on-Lattice/Diego PoC, design pluggable SPI. Effort: 5-7 days.
U7: Update all module docs to include shortDescription. Effort: 2-3 days.
U8: Host/read Python script from HDFS, use shell processor in XD (on CF) to delegate to Py runtime. Effort: 4-6 days.

A1: Wiki Migration (U1)
A2: Hadoop Namenode Configuration (U2)
A3: Jdbchdfs Passthrough Job (U3)
A4: Spring Batch Execution Context Decoupling & XD Upgrade (U4)
A5: Custom Job Module Java Config & Deployment Fix (U5)
A6: Pluggable SPI Design for XD-on-Lattice/Diego (U6)
A7: Module Documentation Update (U7)
A8: Python Script Execution from HDFS via XD Shell Processor (U8)

activities.activity_description: Migrate the wiki to the project repository so that it can be tagged with the code and versioned.
Add Hadoop namenode specifics in a config file to automatically configure DSL sessions without manual pointing.
Implement a jdbchdfs batch job as a passthrough without chunk processing to avoid batch read/write overhead.

activities.activity_name: Spring Batch Execution Context Decoupling & XD Upgrade
activities.activity_description: Decouple execution context from job launch lifecycle in Spring Batch, upgrade XD to the new Batch release, and refactor the XD-2486 workaround.

activities.activity_name: Custom Job Module Java Config & Deployment Fix
activities.activity_description: Create a custom job module using Java Config instead of XML, and fix the deployment/launch error where the job is not found.
Continue the XD-on-Lattice/Diego PoC by designing a pluggable SPI to make it generally applicable, with the Receptor API as one implementation option.
Update all module docs to include a shortDescription so users can learn more about the module.

activities.activity_name: Python Script Execution from HDFS via XD Shell Processor
activities.activity_description: Host/read Python script files from HDFS and use the shell processor in XD (on CF) to delegate data science functionality to the Python runtime and receive feedback.
